title: A line fitted for ages 2 to 10 is used at 40
caption: Within the data (ages 2 to 10) height = 80 + 6 × age is fine, but the same line at age 40 predicts 320 cm: extrapolation far outside the data is not trustworthy.
alt: A solid line for ages 2 to 10 from 92 cm to 140 cm, continuing as a dashed line to age 40 where it reaches 320 cm.
description: The fitted line height = 80 + 6 × age is solid over the data, ages 2 to 10.
Extended to age 40 it gives 80 + 240 = 320 cm.
No adult is 3.2 m tall: the linear pattern does not continue.
